item.title: Helias rolls past Camdenton to win Class 5 District 5 title | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: A good start was a big goal for the Helias Crusaders. Three touchdowns in their first three possessions, that’s a very good start. Helias held a 21-0 lead less than 10 minutes into Friday night’s game as the Crusaders defeated the Camdenton Lakers 30-8 in the Class 5 District 5 Tournament championship game at Ray Hentges Stadium.

item.title: Strong strong sends Blair Oaks past North Callaway for Class 2 District 5 title | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The North Callaway offense had been so successful this season, the Thunderbirds only punted twice in their previous six games entering Friday night’s Class 2 District 5 Tournament championship game against the Blair Oaks Falcons. So when Blair Oaks forced a North Callaway three-and-out to open the game, the Falcon punt return team was ready to make a statement. Kason Lance returned that punt 67 yards for a touchdown less than two minutes into the contest and Blair Oaks never looked back, cruising to a 55-0 win against North Callaway at the Falcon Athletic Complex.
